settings.title: Zigbee Monitor
settings.intro: Regularly tests whether your Zigbee routers (mains-powered devices) still respond. Nothing changes on the device: it gets its current state again.
settings.notify_down: Notify when a router stops responding
settings.notify_up: Notify when a router responds again
settings.search: Search by name, zone or app
settings.repair_text: Create an Advanced Flow: 'A router of [app] does not respond' → Homey's 'Restart app' card (System › Apps) → wait 30 seconds → condition '[router] responds'. Still not responding: 'Zigbee Monitor is running longer than 60 minutes' → 'Restart Homey' (System). Apps are not allowed to restart other apps or Homey itself, so this is done in a flow.
